ETMS_survey_end.block_1/StudyPurpose: Gauging intelligence of people with a quiz then finding the avg. percentile for each user. Making the user aware of the percentile they were placed in and setting up a list of social perception questions to see if it has any negative or positive reaction to it.
ETMS_survey_end.block_1/WereYouEvaluated: Everyone's social perception is hard to compare and not a fair reason to be evaluated without knowing someone's background. However, the quiz can test intelligence.
ETMS_survey_end.block_1/Feedback_interpr: Neutral. I made some mistakes during the quiz but it became pattern recognition when you try to remember the instructions.
ETMS_survey_end.block_1/Suspicious: I wanted to see if getting an error in the quiz would affect any outcome.
